The parameters `min_perf_pct`, `max_perf_pct`, and `cstate_max` remained constant and appeared to have little to no impact during this tuning session.

To make future runs more efficient, focus on a narrower range of `latency_ns` around 10ms and `min_granularity_ns`/`wakeup_granularity_ns` around 7-8ms. The optimal configuration appears to be `latency_ns=10000000`, `min_granularity_ns=7000000`, `wakeup_granularity_ns=7000000`, and `migration_cost_ns=180000`.
